operations.name: codebook-shape
operations.meaning: Validate the exact finite binary codebook and its declared message.

operations.name: proper-prefix-pairs
operations.meaning: List every proper prefix relation between distinct codewords.

operations.name: suffix-universe
operations.meaning: List the finite universe of proper nonempty suffixes bounding residual search.

operations.name: left-quotient
operations.meaning: Compute all residual strings obtained by removing a codeword prefix from the declared word.

operations.name: first-residuals
operations.meaning: Compute the first Sardinas-Patterson residual set, excluding the empty self-match.

operations.name: residual-closure
operations.meaning: Compute the reachable residual graph while retaining an empty residual as a failure-of-uniqueness certificate.

operations.name: unique-decoding-decision
operations.meaning: Compare exact residual reachability with a separately implemented paired decoder automaton.

operations.name: finite-parses
operations.meaning: Enumerate every tokenization of the declared word; preserve multiple parses.

operations.name: message-encoding
operations.meaning: Concatenate the declared codeword indices without asserting unique recovery.

operations.name: message-boundaries
operations.meaning: Report exact cumulative message boundaries and preserve provenance to the token sequence.

operations.name: paired-automaton
operations.meaning: Expose the complete finite paired-decoder graph and its ambiguity reachability.

operations.name: ambiguity-witness
operations.meaning: Return a concrete bit string with two distinct parses when the finite product graph finds one.

operations.name: length-series
operations.meaning: Count token sequences by encoded length using exact integer recurrence through length twelve.

operations.name: kraft-necessity
operations.meaning: Evaluate an exact dyadic Kraft sum and distinguish a necessary condition from a sufficient decision.

operations.name: prefix-versus-unique
operations.meaning: Keep prefix freedom and unique decipherability as separate Boolean facts.

operations.name: reversal-invariance
operations.meaning: Check unique decipherability after reversing every codeword.

operations.name: symbol-renaming-invariance
operations.meaning: Check unique decipherability under the binary alphabet permutation.

operations.name: trinity-analogy
operations.meaning: Represent a synthetic catalogue-transcription analogy without real-world conversion.

operations.name: observation-gap
operations.meaning: Keep absent channel, sampling, calibration and real recovery evidence open.

operations.name: authority-gate
operations.meaning: Hold identity, custody, professional and affected-party actions without their prerequisites.
